nodes.description: MirrorENSRegistrar.register(string,address): external registration entrypoint gated by onlyWriteToken; writes ENS records and reverse records.
MirrorENSRegistrar.changeRootNodeOwner(address): onlyOwner function that transfers the ENS root node ownership via the registry.
MirrorENSRegistrar.updateENSReverseRegistrar(): onlyOwner function that caches the reverse registrar address read from the ENS registry.
MirrorENSRegistrar constructor: sets rootName, rootNode, writeToken and instantiates ensRegistry/ensResolver; also Ownable constructor sets _owner.
Ownable.owner(): view accessor returning the stored _owner address.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that assigns a new owner to _owner.
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender, the source of the caller identity used for all authorization checks.
Context._msgData(): returns msg.data payload of the current call.
string public rootName: human-readable ENS root name (e.g. mirror.xyz) written in the constructor and read during reverse-name composition.
bytes32 public immutable rootNode: namehash of the managed root, used as the parent node for registrations and ownership changes.
IENS public immutable ensRegistry: address of the ENS registry contract used for owner lookups and record writes.
address public immutable writeToken: the only address authorized to call register (checked against msg.sender).
IENSResolver public immutable ensResolver: trusted resolver contract used to set addr and name records.
IENSReverseRegistrar public reverseRegistrar: mutable cache of the reverse registrar, set by updateENSReverseRegistrar and read in register.
bytes32 public constant ADDR_REVERSE_NODE: namehash('addr.reverse') used to look up the reverse registrar owner.
address private _owner: Ownable storage holding the privileged owner address that guards onlyOwner functions.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller identity used to gate register (onlyWriteToken) and the onlyOwner administrative functions.
External call ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord(rootNode, labelNode, owner_, resolver, 0) inside register: writes ENS ownership to an externally supplied account.
External calls ensResolver.setAddr(node, owner_) and ensResolver.setName(reverseNode, name) inside register: forward and reverse record writes to the resolver.
External call ensRegistry.setOwner(rootNode, _newOwner) inside changeRootNodeOwner: hands root-node control to a new address.
External call ensRegistry.owner(ADDR_REVERSE_NODE) inside updateENSReverseRegistrar: uncached external dependency used to populate reverseRegistrar.
string calldata label_: attacker-influenced subdomain label passed into register.
address owner_: destination owner of the registered subdomain in register.
address _newOwner: new root node owner supplied to changeRootNodeOwner.
string rootName_: constructor input stored into rootName.
bytes32 rootNode_: constructor input stored into the immutable rootNode.
address ensRegistry_: constructor input cast to IENS and stored into ensRegistry.
address ensResolver_: constructor input cast to IENSResolver and stored into ensResolver.
address writeToken_: constructor input stored into the immutable writeToken authorization gate.
bytes32 labelNode: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(label_)) used as the ENS subnode label.
bytes32 node: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(rootNode, labelNode)), the derived full node of the subdomain.
string name: reverse record name composed from label_ and rootName.
bytes32 reverseNode: result of reverseRegistrar.node(owner_) used as the reverse record key.
address msgSender: constructor local holding _msgSender() before assigning it to _owner.

edges.reason: register is guarded by onlyWriteToken, which compares msg.sender against writeToken; caller identity therefore controls execution.
changeRootNodeOwner is guarded by onlyOwner, which requires _owner == _msgSender().
updateENSReverseRegistrar is guarded by onlyOwner, which requires _owner == _msgSender().
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner and can irreversibly remove the owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner and reassigns privileged control.
_msgSender() simply returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller identity.
writeToken state variable is read in the onlyWriteToken check that authorizes register.
register invokes the external registry write ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord.
register invokes the external resolver writes setAddr and setName.
changeRootNodeOwner invokes the external registry write ensRegistry.setOwner.
updateENSReverseRegistrar performs the external read ensRegistry.owner(ADDR_REVERSE_NODE).
The external setSubnodeRecord call executes untrusted external code before register completes, enabling reentrant invocation of register.
The external setAddr/setName calls execute untrusted external code while register is mid-execution, enabling reentrancy.
label_ is hashed into the local labelNode.
labelNode is passed as the subnode label to ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord.
rootNode is passed as the parent node to ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord.
owner_ is passed as the owner argument to ensRegistry.setSubnodeRecord.
ensResolver is the target contract of the setAddr and setName calls.
owner_ is written into the forward resolver record via setAddr.
the derived node is used as the record key for setAddr.
the composed name is written into the reverse record via setName.
reverseNode is used as the reverse record key for setName.
rootNode is concatenated with labelNode to derive the full node.
labelNode is concatenated with rootNode to derive the full node.
label_ is concatenated into the reverse record name.
rootName is concatenated into the reverse record name.
reverseRegistrar is called to compute reverseNode for the owner.
_newOwner is passed as the new owner to ensRegistry.setOwner.
rootNode identifies which ENS node has its owner changed.
ADDR_REVERSE_NODE is the lookup key passed to ensRegistry.owner.
ensRegistry is the contract queried for the reverse registrar owner.
updateENSReverseRegistrar writes the reverseRegistrar state variable.
The owner address returned by the external registry read is stored into reverseRegistrar.
The constructor local msgSender is assigned to the _owner state variable.
_msgSender() supplies the value stored in the msgSender local.
constructor parameter rootName_ initializes the rootName state variable.
constructor parameter rootNode_ initializes the immutable rootNode.
constructor parameter ensRegistry_ initializes the immutable ensRegistry.
constructor parameter ensResolver_ initializes the immutable ensResolver.
constructor parameter writeToken_ initializes the immutable writeToken authorization gate.
